details:
Q1. Which area should this issue target? If multiple areas need work, pick the highest-priority one for this issue.
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan workflows
B. Implement / review_autofix workflows
C. Orchestrator / poller / validation workflows
D. Documentation / README / operator-facing guidance
E. Other — reply with the exact workflow name, file path, or subsystem to change (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What exact improvement do you want in that target?
Choices:
A. A broken/incorrect behavior — reply with current behavior and expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Excess noise / flakiness / retries / cost — reply with the specific failure mode or metric to improve (RECOMMENDED)
C. Missing capability / automation — reply with the exact new behavior needed (RECOMMENDED)
D. Docs / clarity / maintainability — reply with the exact confusion, file, or text to improve (RECOMMENDED)
Q3. What should planning use as the success check?
Choices:
A. A link or number for a related issue, PR, workflow run, or log excerpt that shows the problem (RECOMMENDED)
B. A brief acceptance test in plain English (RECOMMENDED)
C. No extra reference — use only the description I provide above
